name: Analog Drumkit
description: 17 velocity-sensitive, sample-free analog percussion voices. GM notes: 35 kick, 36 distorted kick, 37 side stick, 38 snare, 39 clap, 40 electric snare, 41/43/45/47/48/50 low-to-high toms, 42 closed hat, 46 open hat, 49 crash, 51 ride, 54 tambourine. Revised crash wash and ride shimmer; all other sounds and settings retained. BD snappiness, shared hat tuning and snare tuning default to 1 (original sound). Each added voice has its own characteristic control. Finite one-shot tails survive short note-offs; unmapped notes are silent. Stereo output.

hihat_open_highpass::asig.expression: metal1 + metal2 + metal3 + metal4 + metal5 + metal6 + air

hihat_closed_highpass::asig.expression: metal1 + metal2 + metal3 + metal4 + metal5 + metal6 + air

crash_mix::a.expression: metal * body + wash * wash_env * 0.65 + air * fizz * 0.20 + stick * strike * 0.3

ride_mix::a.expression: metal * body + wash * wash_env * 0.55 * brightness + air * fizz * 0.16 * brightness + stick * strike * 0.28 + ping * ping_env

tambourine_pan::asig.expression: (s0 + s1 + s2 + s3 + s4 + s5 + s6) * amplitude
